# The Sydney Morning Herald (SMH.com.au)

> Australia's leading news source covering breaking news, politics, business, sport, and lifestyle with deep coverage of Sydney, NSW, and national affairs.

SMH.com.au is a major Australian news publisher providing comprehensive coverage of federal and state politics, ASX markets, international news, and local Sydney content. The site serves as a primary source for breaking news, political analysis, business intelligence, and lifestyle content for Australian audiences.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Australian Politics
- NSW Politics
- ASX Markets
- World News
- Middle East Conflict
- Sydney Local News
- Interest Rates
- Energy Crisis
- State Elections
- Federal Government
- Business Analysis
- Sports News
- Economic News
- Political Opinion

## News & Breaking News

- [SMH.com.au Homepage](https://www.smh.com.au): SMH.com.au homepage with breaking news, world news, and lifestyle content
- [Sydney Local News](https://www.smh.com.au/sydney-news): Sydney local news, weather, traffic and opinion from The Sydney Morning Herald
- [NSW Breaking News](https://www.smh.com.au#national/nsw): NSW breaking news, headlines and current affairs coverage
- [World Breaking News](https://www.smh.com.au#world): World breaking news and analysis covering Middle East, geopolitics and international relations

## Politics & Government

- [Politics](https://www.smh.com.au#politics): Australian federal and state politics breaking news and analysis
- [Federal Politics](https://www.smh.com.au#politics/federal): Federal politics breaking news covering Albanese government and economy
- [NSW Politics](https://www.smh.com.au#politics/nsw): NSW state politics news and analysis covering Chris Minns government
- [Victoria Politics](https://www.smh.com.au#politics/victoria): Victoria state politics news covering elections and Jacinta Allan government
- [Queensland Politics](https://www.smh.com.au#politics/queensland): Queensland politics news covering state elections and government policy
- [Western Australia Politics](https://www.smh.com.au#politics/western-australia): Western Australia politics news and state government coverage

## Business & Markets

- [Business](https://www.smh.com.au#business): Business news covering ASX markets, economy, finance and international markets
- [Markets & Shares](https://www.smh.com.au#business/markets): ASX market news, share trading and financial market analysis
- [Companies](https://www.smh.com.au#business/companies): Company news and analysis covering ASX stocks and corporate developments
- [Economy](https://www.smh.com.au#business/the-economy): Economic news covering interest rates, inflation and Australian economy
- [Banking & Finance](https://www.smh.com.au#business/banking-and-finance): Banking and finance industry news covering mergers and financial markets
- [Bulls N' Bears](https://www.smh.com.au#business/bullsnbears): ASX-listed company news and CEO interviews with sponsored content

## Sport & Recreation

- [Sport](https://www.smh.com.au#sport): Sports news covering NRL, AFL, cricket, soccer and Australian sports

## Lifestyle & Culture

- [Good Food](https://www.smh.com.au#goodfood): Food guides, recipes, restaurant reviews and dining news for Sydney
- [Lifestyle](https://www.smh.com.au#lifestyle): Lifestyle news covering health, fashion, wellness and daily life advice
- [Traveller](https://www.smh.com.au#traveller): Travel guides, destination inspiration and tourism trends for travellers
